caption:
The thing you forgot

Cella ran the forgotten lunchbox out to the door.

People usually realize they forgot something within a few minutes of leaving, which is when a quick run still works.

For the friend who runs after you with your things.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. A room with a window and a small table with a lunchbox on it. A royal blue figure walks away to the right. A small amber figure with white eyes notices the lunchbox, pushes it across the floor after her, and catches up. The blue one turns, its eyes go wide and then happy with a pulse.
